propositions: Recovery must classify and complete interrupted retirement operations where one identity exists as both live and tombstoned, without guessing across mismatched identities

Keyed and keyless create recovery logic must be extracted into binding_recovery.py while preserving existing labels, grace periods, failure tally behavior, and the recover_pending_bindings facade signature
Retirement completion occurs only when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry agree on exact local_id and Jira key; mismatches or corruption trigger safety abort with evidence retained
Completion removes redundant live forward/reverse entry pair while retaining the tombstone; repeating completion performs no write and is idempotent
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless recovery maintains three-miss plus 3600-second grace requirement with per-entry failure isolation
The create-recovery invocation gate remains UNSCOPED-passes-only with no write-bearing or scope condition changes, preserving behavioral compatibility with existing call sites
